pricing.title: Pay your service fee
pricing.introType1: One-time payment on our website. After checkout, download the VisaMesa app and sign in with the same Google account to start your TIE journey.
pricing.introType2: Complete payment here, then return to the VisaMesa app with the same Google account to unlock your service.
pricing.alreadyPaidTitle: You already have an active service
pricing.alreadyPaidBody: Your payment is linked to this Google account. Open the VisaMesa app and sign in with the same account to continue.
pricing.type2ReturnNote: After payment, use the button on the success page to return to the VisaMesa app.
pricing.securityLead: VisaMesa uses client-side encryption. Your personal information is encrypted on your phone before it reaches our servers.
securityPoints: We store only encrypted data in our database — we cannot read your name, document number, or address without your device.
Encryption keys stay on your device (iOS Keychain / Android Keystore), protected by your passcode or biometrics.
All data in transit is protected with TLS/SSL encryption.
You can export or permanently delete your data at any time in the app.
pricing.securityGdpr: We follow EU GDPR regulations. For full details, see our <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>.
pricing.consentLabel: I accept the <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink> and <termsLink>Terms of Service</termsLink>
pricing.consentRequired: You must accept the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service before continuing to checkout.
